why.distributed_m3: S: NWC distributed over 3.7 billion m3 of drinking water in 2024 (TradeArabia, NWC 2024)
why.nrw: S: NWC non-revenue water 35% (NWC presentation, Water Meets Money 2026, data to March 2026)
why.network_km: S: NWC water network 134.7 thousand km (same presentation)
why.real_loss_share: A: half of NRW is physical leakage (the rest: meter under-registration, unbilled use); IWA water balance
why.hidden_share: A: half of physical leakage is hidden leaks a monitoring system can find (the rest: background seepage below any detector, and visible bursts reported by the public)
why.baseline_days: S: unreported mains leaks run 50 days on average before repair (Lambert 2009, Table 1, IWA)
why.repair_days: S: reported bursts are repaired in about 3 days (Lambert 2009, Table 1)
why.loggers_per_km: A: L-Town's sensor density (33 sensors on 43 km), the density Guardian was tested at
why.logger_sar: A: pressure logger with telemetry, installed (US retail logger USD 1,197, usabluebook PL200-G, plus installation)
why.telemetry_sar_yr: A: SIM/data and battery per logger per year
why.software_sar_yr: A: hosting, maintenance and operator time per 100 km per year
why.wrong_per_km_yr: S: frozen v4/v5 on L-Town: 24.7 wrong-place alarms a year on 43.2 km (development years; tests similar)
why.screened: A: share of wrong-place alarms dropped by the night pressure test before a crew goes out (item 43: 7 of 8 caught where testable)
why.check_sar: S: California default USD 595 per mile surveyed for active leak detection (2020 draft regulation); about one mile per check
why.meter_share: the pre-declared main case of the M1 fresh test: hourly meters on 10% of customers
why.customers_per_km: A: Jeddah DMZ: 16,000 people on 15.9 km (Alsaydalani 2024 + our OSM model), about 6.5 people per connection
why.energy_kwh_m3: A: seawater reverse osmosis energy per m3
